swing.name: Kettlebell Swing
swing.cue: Hinge, not squat. Drive with the hips. The bell floats.

goblet_squat.name: Goblet Squat
goblet_squat.cue: Bell at chest. Sit between your heels. Elbows inside knees.

clean.name: Kettlebell Clean
clean.cue: Lead with the elbow, not the arm. Bell travels a straight line.

press.name: Kettlebell Press
press.cue: Pack the shoulder. Press vertical. The spine does not move.

snatch.name: Kettlebell Snatch
snatch.cue: High pull, then punch through. The bell should float over the top.

tgu.name: Turkish Get-Up
tgu.cue: Eyes on the bell. One movement at a time. Slow is smooth.

halo.name: Kettlebell Halo
halo.cue: Circle the bell around your head. Keep your elbows soft. Shoulders down.

windmill.name: Windmill
windmill.cue: Bell overhead. Push the hip toward the bell. Eyes up.

row.name: Single-arm Kettlebell Row
row.cue: Neutral spine. Drive the elbow back, not the hand up.

renegade_row.name: Renegade Row
renegade_row.cue: Push-up position. Row one bell, brace the other side. No hip rotation.

front_squat.name: Double Kettlebell Front Squat
front_squat.cue: Bells in rack. Squat deep. Elbows stay high. Stand tall.

deadlift.name: Kettlebell Deadlift
deadlift.cue: Push the floor away. Hinge from the hips. Spine neutral.

clean_press.name: Clean and Press
clean_press.cue: Clean to rack. Brief pause. Press from shoulder.

complex.name: Kettlebell Complex
complex.cue: All movements connected. Bell does not touch the ground until the set ends.

figure_eight.name: Figure 8
figure_eight.cue: Low position. Pass the bell between the legs in a figure-eight pattern.

easy_run.name: Easy Run (Zone 2)
easy_run.cue: Conversational pace. Nose breathing. You should be able to speak full sentences.

tempo_run.name: Tempo Run
tempo_run.cue: Comfortably hard. About 85-90% effort. Labored breathing, not gasping.

intervals.name: Interval Run
intervals.cue: Hard on, easy off. Hit your target pace on the work interval. Fully recover on rest.

long_run.name: Long Run
long_run.cue: Easy pace throughout. Duration is the workout. Do not race the long run.

burpee.name: Burpee
burpee.cue: Jump back. Chest to floor. Push up. Jump in. Jump up. Clap overhead.

push_up.name: Push-up
push_up.cue: Rigid plank. Lower until chest touches. Full extension at top.

jump_rope.name: Jump Rope
jump_rope.cue: Light on your feet. Wrists do the work. Land on the balls of your feet.
